ip_blocked.label: Sending IP blocked
ip_blocked.description: The sending server's IP is on a block list. Request delisting at the listing service (the authority) and review what triggered it.

rate_limited.label: Rate limited
rate_limited.description: The recipient domain is throttling mail from this IP. Lower the sending rate and concurrency, then retry later.

auth_failure.label: Sender authentication failed
auth_failure.description: SPF, DKIM, DMARC or reverse DNS checks failed. Review the sending domain's DNS records and the sending server's configuration.

sender_blocked.label: Sender address rejected
sender_blocked.description: The recipient domain rejects mail from this sender address. Ask the recipient's administrator to unblock it, or change the sender address.

content_rejected.label: Content rejected
content_rejected.description: The body or an attachment was rejected as spam, a virus or by policy. Review the message content and attachments.

message_too_large.label: Message too large
message_too_large.description: The message exceeds the recipient's size limit. Reduce the attachments or share them another way.

server_config.label: Sending server misconfigured
server_config.description: Relay, TLS or HELO settings do not meet the recipient's requirements. Check the sending server (MTA) configuration.

unknown_failure.label: Unknown failure
unknown_failure.description: A delivery failure that matches no known pattern. Read the diagnostic and the source messages, and use the analysis report if needed.

dmarc_spf_missing.label: SPF record missing
dmarc_spf_missing.description: Mail with this domain in From failed DMARC because the domain it was checked against (such as the sending server's host name) has no usable SPF record. If the source is a server of the domain, publish an SPF record and set up DKIM signing.

dmarc_dkim_failed.label: DKIM verification failed
dmarc_dkim_failed.description: Mail signed with this domain's DKIM key failed verification and DMARC. Either a forwarder on the receiving side changed the mail or the sending side's DKIM setup is wrong. Check the sending IPs.

dmarc_not_authenticated.label: Sender not authenticated
dmarc_not_authenticated.description: Mail with this domain in From came from sources with neither a DKIM signature of the domain nor SPF authorization, and failed DMARC. Check the sending IPs to tell a legitimate service missing from SPF from spoofing.

user_unknown.label: Recipient does not exist
user_unknown.description: The recipient address does not exist. Remove it from the list or ask the recipient for the correct address.

mailbox_full.label: Recipient mailbox full
mailbox_full.description: The recipient's mailbox is over quota. Nothing can be done on the sending side; mail arrives once they free space.

mailbox_disabled.label: Recipient address disabled
mailbox_disabled.description: The recipient address is disabled or suspended. Remove it from the list or ask the recipient for another address.

domain_not_found.label: Recipient domain not found
domain_not_found.description: The recipient domain has no DNS (MX) record. Check the spelling; otherwise wait for the recipient's DNS to recover.

delivery_delay.label: Delivery delayed
delivery_delay.description: The recipient server is temporarily unreachable. Mail is retried automatically; contact the recipient side only if it persists.

user.usernameHint: The ID used to log in.

mailbox.addressHint: The address to monitor. It is stored in lower case.

mailbox.recentDaysHint: Days to look back on later syncs (default 10)
mailbox.serverKeepDaysHint: Bounces and other notices, and junk mails, older than this many days (from the mail's date) are deleted from the server. 0 never deletes them on the server.
mailbox.serverKeepDaysMax: At most the mail retention of the general settings ({{max}} days).

setting.mailKeepDaysHint: Mails older than this many days, counted from their date, are removed by the daily cleanup. The bounce groups they belonged to are recounted; a group left without mails is removed together with its analysis report.
setting.cleanupTimeHint: Every day at this time, the mails, workspaces and other data past their retention are removed (it can also be started from the Tools page).
setting.workersHint: Number of jobs that run at the same time. Accounts on the same IMAP server are processed one after another automatically.
setting.agentModelExamples: Models you can use (click to fill in)
setting.agentModelUnsupported: This provider does not support choosing a model.
setting.agentReasoningUnsupported: This provider does not support choosing a reasoning level.
setting.agentEnabledHint: When enabled, new bounces found by a sync are analyzed automatically.
setting.agentKeepDaysHint: How many days the workspace directory of each analysis run (prompt, CLI output, report) is kept. Older ones are removed by the daily cleanup.

notification.intervalHint: How many days to wait after the previous mail.
notification.recipientsHint: Choose the users who receive notification mails. Users without an email address can be selected but receive nothing until one is registered.
notification.publicUrlHint: The MailCare URL people open in the browser; links in notification mails are built from it. When empty, the server listen address is used.

mails.chooseMailbox: Choose the mailbox whose messages you want to browse.

mailDetail.title: Message detail
mailDetail.noBodyHint: Both the text and the HTML part are empty. The headers and the raw download are still available.
mailDetail.htmlSandboxNote: The HTML is sanitized and shown with scripts and remote images disabled.

bounce.title: Bounce extraction
bounce.notBounce: This message was not classified as a bounce.

tools.description: Run fetch, grouping and analysis separately or together, rebuild the index, redo the classification, or apply the retentions with a cleanup.
tools.allNote: With "All", one job is expanded per mailbox and they run in parallel within the worker limit.

sync.title: Sync all (fetch, group, analyze)
sync.description: Fetches mail, groups new bounces and analyzes the actionable groups. The same processing as a scheduled sync.

fetch.title: Fetch only
fetch.description: Stores mail not yet fetched from the IMAP server. No grouping or analysis.

group.title: Group only
group.description: Classifies fetched mail that is awaiting grouping, groups it and analyzes the groups awaiting analysis.

analyze.title: Analyze only
analyze.description: Runs the agent analysis, either for groups awaiting analysis or for every actionable group.

reindex.title: Reindex
reindex.description: Rebuilds the index database and re-parses, re-classifies and re-groups every stored raw message.
reindex.warning: This takes a while. Group states and analysis reports are kept only for groups that appear again.

reclassify.title: Reclassify
reclassify.description: Keeps the messages and re-runs only bounce classification and grouping. Use after classification rules change.

cleanup.title: Cleanup
cleanup.description: Deletes the bounces and other notices past the retention of their mail address (except those recognized by subject or sender name alone, and automatically generated messages) and the junk mails from the IMAP server, then removes the mails past the mail retention (original, body sections and index row), the temporary files left by interrupted writes, the old agent workspaces and the jobs finished more than 30 days ago. The server runs this automatically every day at the cleanup time.
cleanup.warning: Mails deleted from the IMAP server cannot be restored. A bounce group left without mails is removed together with its analysis report.

jobs.description: Background processing such as fetching, grouping and analysis. Active jobs refresh automatically. Jobs queued for "All" appear as one child job per mailbox.

mailboxes.sectionRangeHint: The first check looks back the initial fetch days; later checks look back the regular fetch days. "All time" on the Tools page checks every mail regardless of the period.
mailboxes.sectionServerKeepHint: The daily cleanup deletes bounces, auto-replies, DMARC reports and similar notices, and junk mails, from the IMAP server for good. Notices recognized by subject or sender name alone, automatically generated messages and ordinary mail are not deleted. Deleted mails cannot be restored. MailCare keeps its own copy until the mail retention.
